name: Kakuta Shinichi
source: A Konoehara second-year who enjoys karate. More well-built than the average jock. He is part of the disciplinary committee, and found The Departed's notice on one of his patrols. He has a favorable opinion of the protagonist and willingly assists with the investigation.
